title: Circulating Inflammatory Cytokines and Female Reproductive Diseases: A Mendelian Randomization Analysis.

claims.notes: MCSF. 47 cytokines; FDR<0.05 (FDR 7.93e-4); cis window not stated; IVW per stated rule (>1 SNP). cis-eQTL analysis null. Coloc: no significant colocalisation, PP.H4 in Table S11. Exposure-side replication (Folkersen 2020 cis-pQTL, 2 SNPs, same outcome): text OR 1.214 (1.04-1.42) P=.0155, Table 2 OR 1.01 (0.85-1.21). FinnGen release not stated (R7 cited). Read via WebFetch of publisher HTML.
